item.title: An Image Management and Distribution Scheme Based on Harbor and Registry
item.description: 1. The Challenge of a Cross-Region Harbor If all you need is to store image data in a simple way, Registry is an excellent choice as an image repository. Registry not only supports multiple storage backends, but can also be configured with HTTPS certificates and access credentials. Worth noting: Harbor also uses Registry to store image data.
